summary.text: Son of Bellerophon (`bellerophon`) and brother of Hippolochus (`hippolochus-lycian`) and Laodameia (`laodameia-lycian`) — whom Ares slew among the Solymi while Hippolochus fought at Troy and Laodameia bore Sarpedon to Zeus.

story.text: Homer counts Isander among the three children Bellerophon begat in Lycia after he overcame the Chimera and every trial set against him; Ares slew Isander among the Solymi, while golden-reined Artemis struck down his sister Laodameia in wrath.
